profiles.description: Customer card payment received for a completed sale. Gross proceeds from selling goods are credited to the merchant processor balance.
Customer refund: return money to a buyer after a returned purchase or cancellation. Reverse the sale payment back to the customer.
Processor service fees charged to the merchant: card transaction commission and payment processing charges deducted from available balance.
Payout settlement: transfer the available merchant balance out to the business bank account. Bank disbursement sent to the merchant.
Reserve withholding: processor locks available funds in a rolling security reserve. Money moves from available balance into restricted reserve.
Reserve release: processor unlocks previously restricted security funds. Money moves out of the held reserve back into available balance.
